page.layout: Running head at top centre above a rule. Below it, one column of running text, with the continuation of the previous page at the top. Then a centred heading, a sub-heading, and an italic title. Then the text of the main column, one numbered thesis per line, paragraph by paragraph. The catchword "Veram" stands at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Priscos Imperatores Pontificibus ipsis authoritate, & potestate eminuisse, ijsque leges imposuisse. §. 21.
Eandem authoritatem succedentes Imperatores super Pontifices exercuisse. §. 22.
Francorum etiam Reges contra violentiam Pontificis legem Pramaticam sanxiuisse, obseruasseque. §. 23.
Parem sanctionem Hispaniae & Lusitaniae Reges, simi-li causa, aduersus Pontifices tulisse. §. 24.
main_text.head: ELENCHUS DISSERTATIONIS.
In CAP. VI. vz.

head.i: De Officio Principis Christiani erga proprium Episcopum

main_text.p: Inconsultò[?] Bellarminum Principes pios rixarum ad-versus Episcopos, insimulare. §. 1.
Ex Scripturis sacris, à Bellarmino praeter sensum detortis, Principes superbiae denotari. §. 2.
Ut Principes deprimantur, Relativorum (ut potè Pastoris, Patris, Doctoris, &c.) nomina & habitudines inverti. §. 3.
Celsiorem in Ministerio locum externam dignitatis celsitudinem non probare. §. 4.
Ex speciosis Patrum nominibus Bellarminum velitari. §. 5.
Argumentum à similitudine ductum illustrare magis quàm probare. §. 6.
Celebrem illam Carnis & Spiritus aduersus Principes detortam similitudinem ab ipso Nazianzeno membratim refutari. §. 7.
Eandem similitudinem & Rationibus, & Pontificiorum principijs manifesto convelli. §. 8.
Sacerdotes Regibus externa potestate non praecellere, licet Sacerdotium Regno (obiecto, & fine) praemineat. §9.

page.notes: The drop-cap word "Inconsultò" is hard to read: the initial I is large and the next letters are partly hidden, so the word is uncertain. "vz." in the chapter heading is doubtful. The faint mirrored text below the first lines (show-through) and the digitiser's mark in the bottom right corner were left out. The catchword "Veram" also appears at the start of the text block, so it is written once in the catchword and once as the last line of the main text as printed. "Pramaticam" is a printing form and is kept as printed. The thesis numbers appear as printed, with "§9." in the last line without a space.
